content.short: PiratePets is a find-to-earn NFT game with move-to-earn, play-to-earn, and AR.
content.description: PiratePets is a find-to-earn NFT game that blends move-to-earn, play-to-earn, and AR elements into a single immersive experience. The title leverages a real-world map that highlights treasure boxes within a 50-meter radius, inviting players to physically visit each box to unlock it and collect tokens. Movement on the map is driven by real activity—walking, running, cycling, or traveling by car, bike, or public transit—turning everyday motion into in-game progress and rewards.
